name: Zahidul Haque
tagline: I build things that run a real business.
available: Open to collaborating on interesting builds
intro: I'm a self-taught builder from Bangladesh. I don't just write code for the sake of it — I build the software that keeps an actual business running, then I run the business on it.

Most of what I make starts as a problem I personally had: a store that needed a catalogue of 600+ products, 100 posters that needed to post themselves, a desktop app to run the whole operation from one window. I figure out the stack as I go and ship the thing.

background.title: Founder & builder — Lumsoo
background.detail: Running a luxury Korean beauty store end to end: the storefront, the custom theme, the product pipeline, the social automation and the internal tooling. Every part of it is something I built.

background.title: Full-stack, by necessity
background.detail: Taught myself WordPress and WooCommerce theming in PHP, data pipelines in PowerShell and Node, desktop apps in Electron and React, and API integrations against Meta's Graph API — because each one was the next thing standing between me and shipping.

background.title: Ship first, polish after
background.detail: I prefer a working version in front of me over a perfect plan on paper. I scope hard, cut what the data doesn't justify yet, and come back to it when it earns its place.
